canonical_units.label: КУДА ТОЛЬКО НЕ... vs КУДА НИ...: восклицание и уступительно-обобщающее придаточное
canonical_units.decision_model: НИ is used with pronominal words in concessive/generalizing subordinate clauses whose main-clause meaning remains true regardless of the condition. НЕ is used in interrogative/exclamatory constructions such as КУДА ТОЛЬКО НЕ..., which are negative in form but affirmative in meaning.
